# North Carolina Justice Center

> A justice advocacy organization dedicated to advancing opportunity and prosperity for all North Carolinians through policy research, community action, and systemic change.

The North Carolina Justice Center focuses on critical issues affecting low-income communities, including education funding, housing, energy policy, food access, immigration rights, healthcare, and social safety net programs. The organization combines advocacy, research, and community engagement to drive policy solutions.

## Key Topics

- Justice Advocacy
- Low-Income Support
- Policy Research
- Education Funding
- Housing & Energy
- Immigration Rights
- Food Access
- Community Action
- Medicaid
- SNAP
- Leandro
- North Carolina Policy
